english_name: Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan
english_description: Introduces itself in-game as 'Hell's Quagmire — Ai Ruo You Lan' (the archive's own title is 'Ultimate Hell: Ai Ruo You Lan'). Part of the ES II to XKX to 'Hell' branch of the engine family, and a sister build of this collection's zjdyzj ('Fingertip MUD' edition), sharing the same 'Hell' engine core down to an identical master file. Not the same game as zhongjidiyu, another archive in this collection that also happens to carry 'Ultimate Hell' in its name.
